checks.left_summary: Core contracts represent one unit of the underlying asset.
checks.right_summary: Protocol positions use base quantums convertible to full underlying units.

checks.left_summary: BTC, ETH, and SOL use USDT-denominated oracle exposure but USDC P&L without a USDC/USDT conversion; Hyperliquid calls this technically quanto.
checks.right_summary: The protocol definition models base positions against quote quantums and does not establish the same documented quanto treatment.

checks.left_summary: Core perpetual margin and realized P&L accounting are in USDC.
checks.right_summary: Margin caps and quote accounting are denominated in USDC.

checks.left_summary: Validator-published external-market oracle prices feed funding and the composite mark.
checks.right_summary: Validator-consensus oracle prices feed collateral, margin, liquidations, and funding.

checks.left_summary: A composite mark distinct from the oracle drives margin, liquidation, and unrealized P&L.
checks.right_summary: The documented oracle drives collateral and liquidation while liquidity-tier parameters scale margin.

checks.left_summary: Mark-triggered positions first attempt market-order liquidation before backstop handling.
checks.right_summary: Oracle-triggered protocol liquidation orders match resting order-book liquidity with penalty rules.

checks.left_summary: Profitable opposing accounts are ranked when an account or isolated position becomes negative.
checks.right_summary: Randomly chosen offsetting positions can be deleveraged when an account becomes negative.

checks.left_summary: The formula uses a five-second sampled premium, fixed interest component, and hourly averaging.
checks.right_summary: The formula uses proposer-voted premiums and governance-adjustable sampling and clamp parameters.

checks.left_summary: The documented core-perpetual cap is four percent per hour.
checks.right_summary: The cap depends on governance-controlled initial and maintenance margin parameters.

checks.left_summary: Documentation describes size constraints, but no account-specific point-in-time limit capture exists.
checks.right_summary: Governance and liquidity-tier parameters are dynamic, and no point-in-time constraint capture exists.

checks.left_summary: Fees vary with rolling volume and account conditions; the effective account tier is not captured.
checks.right_summary: Maker-taker fees are governance-adjustable; the effective account tier is not captured.

checks.left_summary: Liquidation and deleveraging mechanisms are documented, but operational independence has not been assessed.
checks.right_summary: Liquidation and deleveraging mechanisms are documented, but correlated oracle, bridge, and outage exposure has not been assessed.

checks.left_summary: Technical contract documentation does not establish the operator's legal or interface eligibility.
checks.right_summary: Protocol source and technical documentation do not establish the operator's legal or interface eligibility.
